name: coding
title: Coding
scope: Use this card to read a problem, name inputs and outputs, sketch pseudocode, estimate big-O, and check edge cases.
method: Read the problem until the asked result is clear.
Name the inputs and the outputs.
Estimate big-O as O(1), O(n), O(n log n), or O(n^2).
Check edge cases such as empty input, one item, and the boundary.
Use a stack trace only when one was actually provided.
Stop when the sketch matches the inputs, the output, and the cost.

formulas.name: constant
formulas.use: Work does not grow with input size, as with a direct lookup.

formulas.name: linear
formulas.use: One pass over n items, as with a single scan.

formulas.name: linearithmic
formulas.use: A typical efficient sort or balanced divide of n items.

formulas.name: quadratic
formulas.use: Nested passes over the same n items, which grows quickly.

checks: The big-O label is O(1), O(n), O(n log n), or O(n^2), with a reason.
Edge cases were checked, and no stack trace was invented.
limits: Editing a repository still follows the code tools.
Do not invent a stack trace.
